summary: The lamp button only works sometimes because loop() contains two 1-second delay calls, making the sketch unresponsive for 2 seconds at a time.

causes.title: One pass of loop() took 2.00 s
causes.why: Anything that must react quickly waits this long due to delay(1000) calls in loop(): `delay(1000);` on line 17 and `delay(1000);` on line 19.
causes.check: Watch the Serial Monitor while tapping the button repeatedly to see if presses during the delay are ignored.
causes.fix: Remove the delay() calls and use millis()-based non-blocking timing instead.

rule_findings.title: One pass of loop() took 2.00 s
rule_findings.evidence: Anything that must react quickly (buttons, sensors, motors) waits this long.
rule_findings.fix: Look for delay() or blocking calls in loop(); use millis() timing instead.
